title: Opto-digital molecular analytics
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,3557-3577
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00023H, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chelsea Violita Stanley, Yi Xiao, Tong Ling, Dong-Sheng Li, Peng Chen
This article reviews the recent advances in opto-digital molecular analytics, offers insights and comparative discussions on both emission and scattering-based digital detection, and discusses the current challenges and future possibilities.
